items.exampleEn: As a child, she wanted to be an astronomer.
items.exampleZh: 她小時候想當天文學家。

items.exampleEn: Phones have changed a lot because of technological progress.
items.exampleZh: 由於科技進步，手機改變了很多。

items.exampleEn: Fish get oxygen from the water.
Some exams have an oral part and a written part.
items.exampleZh: 有些考試分為口試部分和筆試部分。

items.exampleEn: The Earth's orbit around the sun takes one year.
items.exampleZh: 地球沿著繞太陽的軌道走一圈需要一年。

items.exampleEn: She teaches mathematics at a high school.
We need an experienced driver for this long trip.
items.exampleZh: 這趟長途旅行我們需要一位有經驗的司機。

items.exampleEn: This robot can cook simple meals.
items.exampleZh: 這個機器人會煮簡單的餐點。

items.sentenceEn: The astronomer found a new star.
items.sentenceZh: 天文學家發現了一顆新的星星。

items.audioEn: The astronomer's talk about the moon's orbit is free for students, but other visitors pay five dollars.
items.audioZh: 天文學家關於月球軌道的演講學生免費，其他訪客要付五元。
items.questionZh: 學生聽演講要付多少錢？

items.sentenceEn: There is less oxygen high in the mountains.

items.sentenceZh: 他是一位經驗豐富的老師。

items.stemEn: Our team built a ____ that can clean the floor by itself.
items.stemZh: 我們團隊做了一個能自己清掃地板的機器人。
植物在白天會製造氧氣。

items.passageEn: Last month, an experienced astronomer visited our school. She has worked at a space center for twenty years. In her talk, she explained how satellites stay in orbit around the Earth. She said people who travel to space must bring oxygen because there is no air there. She also showed us a small robot that can move on the moon's surface. She told us that mathematics is very important for anyone who wants to work in space science. She also said technological change is making space travel cheaper. After the talk, every student gave a short oral report.
items.passageZh: 上個月，一位經驗豐富的天文學家來我們學校。她在太空中心工作了二十年。演講中，她解釋了衛星怎麼留在繞地球的軌道上。她說去太空的人必須帶氧氣，因為那裡沒有空氣。她也給我們看一台能在月球表面移動的小機器人。她告訴我們，對想從事太空科學工作的人來說，數學非常重要。她也說，科技的變化正讓太空旅行變得更便宜。演講結束後，每位學生都做了簡短的口頭報告。

questions.questionZh: 這位天文學家在太空中心工作多久了？
演講後每位學生做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 月球沿著繞地球的軌道移動。
referenceEn: The moon moves in an orbit around the Earth.
The moon travels in its orbit around the Earth.
rubricZh: orbit 表示「軌道」，例如 in an orbit around… 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 爺爺常常講村裡流傳的口述故事給我們聽。
referenceEn: My grandfather often tells us the oral stories of the village.
My grandpa often tells us oral stories from the village.
rubricZh: 用 oral 表示「口述的；口頭流傳的」（例如 oral stories）
